name: nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser
description: Recalculates the running payment credit balance for a single user (optionally scoped to one kennel) and writes the result back to three tables: HC.Payment.CreditAvailable (per-payment running balance), HC.HasherKennelMap.KennelCredit (current balance summary), and HC.KennelCredit (legacy credit table, kept in sync until retired). Called inside and after transactions by portal and app payment SPs. Returns nothing.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Hasher whose credit balances to recalculate.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Scope to a single kennel. NULL = recalculate credit across all kennels for this user. Default NULL.

sideEffects: Updates HC.Payment.CreditAvailable and HC.Payment.updatedAt for all uncancelled payments for the user (optionally scoped to @kennelId) where the running balance has changed.
Updates HC.HasherKennelMap.KennelCredit and HC.HasherKennelMap.updatedAt for the latest payment per kennel where the balance has changed.
Updates HC.KennelCredit.currentBalance, HC.KennelCredit.balanceAsOfEventId, HC.KennelCredit.updatedAt for existing rows where the balance or event has changed.
Inserts new rows into HC.KennelCredit for kennels where no existing row exists and the balance is non-zero.

codeSmells.issue: HC.KennelCredit is a legacy table — kept in sync but marked for retirement
codeSmells.detail: The SP comment explicitly flags HC.KennelCredit as a legacy table to be removed when retired. Until then, every credit recalculation must maintain three separate tables. The dual-update pattern adds complexity and two additional write paths that must stay in sync.

The SP has no TRY/CATCH. An error in any of the three UPDATE/INSERT steps propagates as a raw exception to the caller. Since this SP is typically called inside a caller's transaction, a raw exception will roll back that transaction correctly — but partial updates within this SP body are possible if XACT_ABORT does not cover all cases.
